# 06 — Public pages through RPCs: manage-booking, feedback, prefill, find-or-create

Tonda's public pages read tables directly with the anon key. `ManageBooking.jsx` selects the whole
reservation row (`select('*')`, line 25) and the guest's name, phone and email from Round's `customers`
(line 38); `Feedback.jsx` reads `feedback` rows, generates the voucher code in the browser
(`generateVoucherCode`, line 12) and POSTs the insert itself (`insertFeedback`, line 22);
`supabaseCustomers.js` finds and patches customers with raw selects and updates; the phone prefill in
`Reservations.jsx` (`handlePhoneBlur`, line 328) and `ExperienceDetail.jsx` (line 66) looks a customer up
by phone and returns the full name and email to anyone who types a number. All of that needs anon table
access, so Tonda 10 and Round 06 cannot lock the tables while it exists. After this package every one of
those paths goes through a narrow `security definer` RPC: two new ones on Tonda (`get_booking`,
`feedback_reservation`, in this package's migration) and the Round RPCs from Round 04
(`find_or_create_customer`, `customer_prefill`, `customer_display_name`, `feedback_state`,
`submit_feedback`). The vouchers are now generated by the server, prefill returns a first name only, and
the manage page no longer shows the guest's phone or email.

Branch: `build/06-public-pages-rpcs`
Brainstormed: 2026-10-17. Decisions made by Claude under Perng's 2026-10-17 'work autonomously' instruction; see docs/build/2026-10-17-audit-plan.md.
Depends on: Round 04 migration applied before deploy (the Round RPCs below must exist). Also Round 05's
`send-voucher-email` (takes `{reservation_id}` only) deployed before this ships; the plan's merge order
(Round 05 is order 4, this is order 6) already guarantees it. Builders can build and unit-test without
either: Round calls are mocked in vitest. Tonda 03 must be merged first for the SQL test harness (see
Tasks, T1).

---

## Plan discrepancies

1. **`Reservations.jsx` ownership is slightly too tight.** The plan lets 06 touch `handlePhoneBlur` and "the
   `findOrCreateCustomer` call". The call at lines 456–461 needs **no** edit (the exported signature
   `findOrCreateCustomer({ full_name, phone, email, birthdate })` is unchanged). But the birthday prompt at
   line 664 reads `existingCustomer.birthdate`, which prefill no longer returns; it must read
   `has_birthdate`. That one-token edit is required and is in this brief. Everything else in
   `Reservations.jsx` stays with Tonda 05.
2. **Prefill no longer fills email.** `handlePhoneBlur` currently fills `full_name` and `email` from the
   match (lines 341–345). `customer_prefill` returns `first_name` and `has_birthdate` only, so email stays
   as the guest typed it. This follows the plan's decision (returning email is the leak).
3. **ManageBooking loses the guest's phone and email** (lines 108–109). The plan names
   `customer_display_name` (first name only, per the plan's Opus review) and does not say what happens to the other two fields. Tonda's
   `reservations` has no phone or email, so they are removed from the page.
4. **`get_booking` columns.** The plan says "the columns ManageBooking renders (no `notes` beyond what it
   shows today)". The page does render `notes` (line 132), `baby_chairs`, `pets`, `reservation_date`,
   `reservation_time`, `guest_count` and `status`, plus `customer_id` for the name lookup. Those eight
   are the return columns. No `table_ids`, `needs_manual_assignment`, `id` or `table_type`.
5. **Orphan:** `src/lib/voucher.js` (`voucherExpiry`) and its test are used only by `Feedback.jsx`
   (line 5). Once the server issues vouchers they are dead, so this package deletes both.
6. **`functions.invoke` does not throw on a failed call** (it returns `{ error }`), so the existing
   `try/catch` around `send-voucher-email` (lines 179–192) never logs a failure. The rewritten call checks
   `error`.
7. **Lint baseline:** CLAUDE.md says 14 problems; Tonda 02 measured 16 (11/5). Record the number on a clean
   checkout (T0). The gate is no more than that.

## Decisions

| Question | Chosen | Rejected | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tonda migration | `get_booking(p_id uuid)` returns the columns ManageBooking renders (no `notes` beyond what it shows today), and `feedback_reservation(p_id uuid) returns table(customer_id uuid, status text)`. Both are anon+authenticated security definer. | Keep anon `select` on `reservations` | Tonda 10 locks `reservations` to authenticated |
| Manage link | ManageBooking uses `get_booking` + Round `customer_display_name`, and `isPast` uses `getLocalToday()`. The manage link stays `/booking/<uuid>`: the uuid stays the credential and stops being listable after Tonda 10. **(Claude)** | A new token column | It would break every link already emailed |
| Feedback | Feedback.jsx uses `feedback_reservation` + Round `feedback_state` / `submit_feedback`, and `send-voucher-email` gets `{reservation_id}` only. It keeps the BRANDS check, and the `restaurant` must be `'tonda'` for a Tonda reservation. | Client-side voucher and raw REST insert | Voucher and one-per-reservation rule belong on the server |
| find-or-create | `supabaseCustomers.js` `findOrCreateCustomer` calls Round `find_or_create_customer`, with the same exported signature so Events/Offsite/Reservations callers are untouched. | Change the callers | Callers belong to other packages |
| Prefill | `handlePhoneBlur` (Reservations) and the ExperienceDetail prefill use `customer_prefill` and fill the first name only. The birthday prompt uses `has_birthdate`. **(Claude)** | Return email too; drop prefill | Email is the leak; dropping it is worse for returning guests |
| Experience registration | ExperienceDetail registration validates the phone with `isValidPhone` and rejects pax < 1. | Leave `parseInt(...) \|\| 1` coercion | A bad phone or 0 guests currently reach the table |
| Round RPC contract | Signatures exactly as in the plan's "Round 04" section (listed under Tasks) | Anything else | Round briefs are written in parallel against the same list |

## Invariants touched

- **Availability / table assignment server-side:** not touched. `cancel_reservation` (ManageBooking
  line 51) is unchanged.
- **Dates as local `YYYY-MM-DD` from `getLocalToday()`:** `ManageBooking.isPast` (line 93) is fixed to comply.
- **Customer counters on Round's `customers`:** this package does not touch counters or `customer_visits`.
  `find_or_create_customer` only fills missing fields (server side), same as today's `missingFieldsPatch`.
- **Round's `customers`/`feedback` are shared with Round:** all Round calls go to existing/new RPCs; no schema
  change on Round from this package.
- **`day_type`, `closed_days` jsonb, admin theme:** not touched. The new SQL does not reference them.

## Tasks

Global: work only in the files named; stage by path; `npm test` must pass; lint no worse than the T0 count;
commit messages end with the attribution lines the harness gives you. Match surrounding style (no
semicolons, single quotes, 2-space indent). Do not run anything against the live Supabase projects;
Round calls are mocked in tests.

Round RPC signatures (from the plan, "Round 04"; use exactly these names and parameter names):
- `find_or_create_customer(p_full_name text, p_phone text, p_email text, p_birthdate date) returns uuid`
- `customer_prefill(p_phone text) returns table(first_name text, has_birthdate boolean)`
- `customer_display_name(p_id uuid) returns text`
- `feedback_state(p_reservation_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_restaurant text) returns text` — `'submitted' | 'repeat' | 'new'`
- `submit_feedback(p_reservation_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_restaurant text, p_nps_score int, p_tags text[], p_comment text) returns table(voucher_code text, voucher_expires_at timestamptz)` — voucher columns are null for repeat feedback
- all called with `supabaseCustomers.rpc(...)` (the Round-project client in `src/supabaseCustomers.js`).

### T1 — Migration and PGlite tests
**Do:** Create `supabase/migrations/20261017100200_public_booking_rpcs.sql` with a header comment stating the
purpose and that it must be applied by the owner (`supabase db push`), not from a worktree. Two functions,
both `language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp`:
```sql
create or replace function public.get_booking(p_id uuid)
returns table (
  reservation_date date, reservation_time time, guest_count int, status text,
  notes text, baby_chairs int, pets boolean, customer_id uuid
)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select r.reservation_date, r.reservation_time::time, r.guest_count::int, r.status::text,
         r.notes::text, coalesce(r.baby_chairs, 0)::int, coalesce(r.pets, false), r.customer_id
  from public.reservations r where r.id = p_id;
$$;

create or replace function public.feedback_reservation(p_id uuid)
returns table (customer_id uuid, status text)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select r.customer_id, r.status::text from public.reservations r where r.id = p_id;
$$;
```
then for each: `revoke all on function … from public;` and
`grant execute on function … to anon, authenticated;`. Use `language sql` (not plpgsql) so the output
column names do not clash with the table columns. Add the file
`supabase/tests/pglite/public_booking_rpcs.test.mjs` using the harness from Tonda 03 (copy the setup and
helper usage from the existing test files in that folder; read them first). Load the new migration file from
disk into the PGlite instance after the stub schema. Cases: (a) `get_booking` for a seeded reservation returns
exactly the 8 columns, with the right values; (b) `Object.keys(row)` equals
`['reservation_date','reservation_time','guest_count','status','notes','baby_chairs','pets','customer_id']`
(proves no `table_ids` / `needs_manual_assignment` leak); (c) unknown uuid returns zero rows; (d) `null`
returns zero rows; (e) `feedback_reservation` returns `customer_id` and `status` for a seeded row and zero rows
for an unknown id; (f) if the stub defines `anon` / `authenticated` roles: `has_function_privilege` is true
for both on both functions and false for a role that has no grant. If the stub schema lacks a `reservations`
column used above (`notes`, `baby_chairs`, `pets`), add it to the stub and say so in the PR body.
**Verify:** `npm run test:sql` passes with the new file included; `grep -c "security definer" supabase/migrations/20261017100200_public_booking_rpcs.sql` equals 2;
`grep -n "grant execute" supabase/migrations/20261017100200_public_booking_rpcs.sql` shows 2 lines.

## Out of scope

- The Round side of every RPC (Round 04) and `send-voucher-email` changes (Round 05).
- Locking down anon table access (Tonda 10, Round 06).
- Dropping `BRANDS.round` or any Round branding in `Feedback.jsx`.
- `Events.jsx` / `Offsite.jsx` (they keep calling `findOrCreateCustomer`; owned by Tonda 09).
- Everything in `Reservations.jsx` except the two places named (Tonda 05).
- A token column for manage links; showing phone/email on the manage page.
- `docs/build/README.md` index rows (the orchestrator adds them to avoid parallel-branch conflicts).
